answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales linearly with capital commitment, preventing a hollow attacker from dominating via cheap, spoofed identities. Each node acts as a distinct vertex in the network topology, requiring a cryptographic cipher to verify asset ownership. Because forging signatures without private keys is computationally infeasible, an attacker must bear the immense capital cost of acquiring tokens to dilute consensus.
